purpose: Answer a question about the finished video from retrieved records only (SPEC 59, 80, 93). Grounded: every claim traces to a record, and a question the records cannot answer is refused rather than guessed.

records.description: The retrieved moments, events and clips, one per line with an id.

answer.description: Two or three sentences, from the records.

citations.description: Ids of the records the answer relied on.

answered.description: False when the records do not contain the answer.
